description.en: Carries your devices' encrypted traffic through a relay in your own Cloudflare account when they can't connect directly, and keeps encrypted sync mail for a device that is away. The relay sees which of your devices talk and how much, never what.
Where your relay Worker runs, such as https://clover-relay.<your-subdomain>.workers.dev

auth.help: The RELAY_KEY you gave your relay Worker (wrangler secret put RELAY_KEY): at least 32 random bytes, base64url.
